continue.description: Default true. false stops Claude entirely after the hook runs, and beats an event-specific decision. It does not by itself block a PreToolUse tool call.

stopReason.description: Shown to the user when continue is false. It stays in the conversation, so Claude sees it later.

systemMessage.description: A warning shown to the user, not added to Claude's context. Capped at 10,000 characters; longer text is saved to a file and replaced by its path and a 2,000 character preview.

terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

behavior.description: allow grants the permission, deny refuses it. A hook cannot approve what a deny rule refuses.

updatedInput.description: allow only: replaces the tool's whole input. The result is checked against deny and ask rules again.

type.description: addRules adds the rules; replaceRules replaces every rule of that behavior at the destination; removeRules removes the matching ones.

toolName.description: The tool the rule names, such as Bash or mcp__github__get_issue.

ruleContent.description: The rule's specifier, such as npm test for Bash(npm test). Omit it to match the whole tool; always omit it for an MCP tool.

rules.description: The permission rules to add, replace or remove.

destination.description: Where the change is written: session is in memory only; the others are .claude/settings.local.json, .claude/settings.json and ~/.claude/settings.json.

mode.description: The mode to switch to; manual is an alias for default. bypassPermissions only takes effect when the session was launched with bypass mode available.

items.description: A permission update entry; type decides its other fields.

updatedPermissions.description: allow only: permission updates to apply, such as an allow rule so the user is not asked again.

message.description: deny only: tells Claude why the permission was denied.

title: PermissionRequest hook output
description: Grants or denies the request on the user's behalf. Exit code 2 is not read as a decision here: return the decision object.
